blurb.text: A regional wine area covering the same ground as the Vinho Verde DOC, differing mainly in allowing international grapes the DOC excludes. Loureiro leads plantings at 30 percent, followed by Arinto and Alvarinho at 16 percent each, with Vinhão, Azal and Trajadura also grown.
